---
title: "OS non-proportional hazards — estimands"
subtitle: "Standardized survival and 182-day RMST from the time-varying-effect model"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(rstanarm)
library(survival)
library(mice)
library(ggdist)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "survival.R"))

main_dir <- here("analysis", "02-overall-survival", "01-main", "results")
results_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "02-overall-survival", "02-non-proportional-hazards", "results"
)
figure_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "figures")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

indices <- seq_len(config$imputation$m_supporting)
n_draws <- config$posterior_draws$supporting
horizon_days <- config$analysis$horizon_days
```

## Standardized survival curves and RMST

```{r}
#| label: derive-supporting-os-nph-estimands
#| include: false

pooled_curves <- indices |>
  map(function(index) {
    model <- readRDS(
      file.path(results_dir, "models", sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
    )
    standardization_data <- readRDS(
      file.path(main_dir, "imputations", sprintf("imputation-%02d.rds", index))
    ) |>
      complete(1) |>
      mutate(mgps = factor(mgps, levels = 0:2))

    # Same seed for both groups, so each draw pairs ctDNA and usual-care curves.
    posterior_standardized_survival_draws(
      model,
      standardization_data,
      horizon = horizon_days,
      n_points = 200L,
      n_draws = n_draws,
      seed = config$seeds$supporting + (index - 1) * 1000 + 100
    ) |>
      mutate(tx = as.integer(tx), imputation = index)
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

pooled_rmst <- pooled_curves |>
  compute_rmst_draws(
    horizon = horizon_days,
    group_cols = c("tx", "imputation")
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = tx, values_from = rmst, names_prefix = "rmst_") |>
  arrange(imputation, draw) |>
  mutate(rmst_diff = rmst_1 - rmst_0)

rmst_summary <- pooled_rmst |>
  summarise(
    mean = mean(rmst_diff),
    median = median(rmst_diff),
    ci_66_low = quantile(rmst_diff, 0.17, names = FALSE),
    ci_66_high = quantile(rmst_diff, 0.83, names = FALSE),
    ci_95_low = quantile(rmst_diff, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    ci_95_high = quantile(rmst_diff, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    probability_benefit = mean(rmst_diff > 0),
    horizon_days = horizon_days,
    imputations = n_distinct(imputation),
    draws_per_imputation = n_draws
  )

curve_summary <- pooled_curves |>
  summarise(
    median = median(survival),
    lower = quantile(survival, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    upper = quantile(survival, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    .by = c(tx, time)
  )

write_parquet(
  pooled_curves,
  file.path(results_dir, "survival-curves.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  pooled_rmst,
  file.path(results_dir, "rmst-draws.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  rmst_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "rmst-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

## Figures

```{r}
#| label: build-supporting-os-nph-plots
#| include: false

prepared <- read_parquet(file.path(main_dir, "prepared.parquet")) |>
  mutate(tx_plot = group_factor(tx))

km_fit <- survfit2(
  Surv(survival_time_days, event_death) ~ tx_plot,
  data = prepared,
  conf.type = "log-log"
)

survival_plot <- plot_km_model(km_fit, curve_summary, x_max = horizon_days)

rmst_plot <- plot_posterior(
  pooled_rmst$rmst_diff,
  x_label = paste0(
    "Difference in ", horizon_days,
    "-day restricted mean survival time (ctDNA − usual care), days"
  )
)

save_figure(
  ggsurvfit_build(survival_plot),
  file.path(figure_dir, "kaplan-meier-vs-nph-model.png"),
  height = 6.5
)
save_figure(rmst_plot, file.path(figure_dir, "rmst-difference-posterior.png"))
```
